Be excellent to each other. 🎸
skills.description_zh: 召唤传奇人物到你的小隔间。14位哲学家、战士、艺术家、领袖，助你决策、创意和人生难题。迷茫时找马可·奥勒留，固执时找李小龙，恐惧时找塔布曼，自欺时找芒格。或与卢弗斯一起锻造属于你的传奇。善待彼此。🎸
skills.name: Wyld Stallyns: Be Excellent 🎸

skills.description: Query headlines and articles from a self-hosted FreshRSS instance. Use when the user asks for RSS news, latest headlines, feed updates, or wants to browse articles from their FreshRSS reader. Supports filtering by category, time range, and count.
skills.description_zh: 查询自建 FreshRSS 实例的标题和文章。用于用户请求 RSS 新闻、最新标题、动态更新或浏览 FreshRSS 阅读器文章。支持按分类、时间范围和数量筛选。
skills.name: FreshRSS Reader
